findings.claim: At the observed selection nodes, landmark_00 occupancy contrasts are signed and favorable-versus-comparison: occupancy3 raw correlation is positive (whole-window mean +0.042, CI excludes zero, p=0.028, q=0.116) while softmin raw correlation is negative (whole-window mean -0.042, CI excludes zero, p=0.026, q=0.116). These are selection-enrichment contrasts at observed nodes, not an absolute geometric descriptor of the pose.

Multiplicity-adjusted support weakens the point-estimate ranking: the same landmark_00 occupancy3/softmin raw-covariance contrasts have p=0.047/0.072 but q=0.151/0.189, and the adjusted-covariance versions are non-significant (q=0.30/0.36). Ranking by point estimate alone would over-prioritize these; after adjustment only the correlation-form contrasts remain the strongest candidates.

Independent-batch agreement is partial, not unanimous: same-sign batch fractions are 0.71 for softmin and occupancy3 raw correlation and 0.64-0.86 across the covariance variants, with 14 independent batches. The counterexample that would weaken the proposed direction is a batch subset where the occupancy3 sign flips to negative (or softmin to positive); reproducibility is therefore moderate and the direction should be used with reduced confidence.

Continuous landmark_00 local-coordinate trends are non-monotone and poorly fit: sign_changes range 4-10, strong_sign_conflicts 1-9, relative_node_RMSE 0.29-0.78, and polynomial_accepted is false with extrapolation_allowed false for all read rows. First-rate and last-rate z-values have opposite signs (e.g. local_dy first_rate_z -72.4 vs last_rate_z +5.5), so a constant rule is not supported and a time-conditioned rule would require validated fits that are not available.

hypotheses.direction: Increase occupancy3-type occupancy and decrease softmin-type occupancy at the observed selection nodes.
hypotheses.falsifier: A batch subset with reversed sign (occupancy3 negative or softmin positive) or adjusted-covariance significance loss would weaken the direction.
hypotheses.observable: landmark_00_occupancy3 and landmark_00_softmin contrast values at observed score nodes over the full observed window.
hypotheses.scope: Observed selection nodes, complete observed window [0.0,0.5]; coordinate contrast only, not an absolute geometric target.
hypotheses.statement: Signed landmark_00 occupancy contrasts (occupancy3 positive, softmin negative) at observed selection nodes carry reproducible favorable-versus-comparison information beyond common motion.

limitations: Only landmark_00 features were read; other landmarks and regional/joint diagnostics were not inspected, so no global pose or shape claim is made.
No adjusted or joint diagnostic read here establishes that landmark_00 adds information beyond common motion; the raw-versus-adjusted covariance difference is noted but not resolved.
Continuous trends are non-monotone with rejected polynomial fits and no extrapolation, so no time-conditioned rule is supported.
No current-study outcome data are available; findings are descriptive contrasts, not causal selection effects or physical interaction energies.
No reward recipe is proposed here; whether a permitted registered recipe can express the occupancy contrast remains untested.
